fields.description: Privacy: by default the badge scanner works without showing the camera image, so employees never feel filmed. Enable this to show a live preview on the kiosk instead.
fields.label: Show Camera Preview on Kiosk

fields.description: Play a short confirmation sound on the kiosk after a successful punch (rising tone for IN, falling tone for OUT).
fields.label: Play Sounds on Kiosk

fields.description: Kiosk terminals opening /kiosk?token=... are logged in as this user automatically. Must be a dedicated user with only the Timeclock Kiosk role.
fields.label: Kiosk Auto-Login User

fields.description: Shared secret for the kiosk start URL (min. 20 characters). Changing it locks out all devices immediately until their URL is updated.
fields.label: Kiosk Auto-Login Token
